assessment: The authors provide single RNA-seq analysis of traumatic brain injury (TBI) that particularly addresses the question of why older individuals may have poor recovery. Compelling complementary and high-end approaches are taken to demonstrate the long-lasting effects that TBI drives in the brain. This important manuscript will be of interest to readers in the field(s) of neuroimmunology, aging, and traumatic brain injury.
